explication: Neko is a self-hosted virtual desktop/browser that streams an isolated Linux desktop to one or more users over WebRTC. A user loads the Vue client, authenticates through the HTTP API, joins a session over WebSocket, and receives audio/video while control, clipboard, keyboard, chat, and file actions are dispatched back to the server. Session management coordinates membership and permissions; desktop and capture layers access X11 and GStreamer. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime wiring; some API handlers and plugin routes are represented at their enclosing paths.
